name: How to prepare your website for AI search

step.name: Step 1: Audit Crawl Access and Indexing: Start by checking your robots.txt file and hosting settings. Ensure AI crawlers (like OAI-SearchBot for ChatGPT or Google-Extended) aren't accidentally blocked from important pages. If they can't crawl it, they can't cite it! Check your Google Search Console for any indexing errors.

Ensure AI crawlers (like OAI-SearchBot for ChatGPT or Google-Extended) aren't accidentally blocked from important pages. If they can't crawl it, they can't cite it! Check your Google Search Console for any indexing errors.

step.name: Step 2: Optimize Internal Linking and Page Experience: Make sure your internal links are logical and that crucial pages are easily reachable. A good internal linking structure helps AI understand the hierarchy and relationships within your content. Also, a fast-loading, mobile-friendly site with a great user experience (page experience) is always a win, as it signals quality to all search systems.

A good internal linking structure helps AI understand the hierarchy and relationships within your content. Also, a fast-loading, mobile-friendly site with a great user experience (page experience) is always a win, as it signals quality to all search systems.

step.name: Step 3: Enhance Visible Text and Structured Data: Your main service explanations and answers should be in clear, visible text – not buried in images or complex JavaScript. Use structured data (JSON-LD schema like Service or LocalBusiness) to explicitly tell AI systems what your content is about. Crucially, this schema *must* accurately reflect the visible content on your page; don't try to stuff it with irrelevant keywords.

step.name: Step 4: Clarify Services, Locations, and Target Customers: Be incredibly clear about what services you offer, where you offer them (if local), and who your ideal customers are. AI systems excel at understanding entities and relationships, so clear, consistent information helps them connect your business to relevant queries.

step.name: Step 5: Improve Useful, Reliable, People-First Content: This is huge. AI systems are designed to provide helpful, trustworthy answers. Focus on creating content that genuinely answers questions people ask, and back it up with verifiable facts. Avoid generic, AI-generated fluff; aim for fact density and semantic relevance.

step.name: Step 6: Validate Changes Through Monitoring: Once you've made changes, monitor your search performance and analytics. Look for improvements in visibility, citations, and qualified traffic. Pay attention to how your content is appearing in AI Overviews or answer snippets. This feedback loop helps you refine your strategy.
step.text: When Professional Guidance Helps: If your website has complex technical issues, deals with a lot of content, or if you're navigating a site migration, bringing in a specialist can be really beneficial. They can help navigate technical nuances and ensure your changes are effectively implemented without negatively impacting your revenue-generating pages.
